Hi all — apologies for the slight delay. We've completed the SIG crosswalk sections for isolation, key management, and data residency. Summary highlights below and attached artifacts: fintrust_control_matrix_filled_template.xlsx, audit-log-sample.txt (redacted).

Isolation / Multi-tenancy:
- Control: Logical tenant isolation is implemented using per-tenant namespaces in the serving runtime and network segmentation at the pod/VM layer.
- Evidence: architecture diagram (page 2 of the attached matrix) and design note referencing our dedicated-tenant allocation policy.

Key management:
- Control: Customer keys are supported via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and we offer a Dedicated mode with customer-managed key option. Keys in-host are never exportable; HSM-backed KMS is used for private deployments.
- Evidence: KMS integration diagram and KMS policy excerpt (see matrix notes).

Telemetry / Audit logs:
- Control: Activity logs are retained by default for 90 days in the hosted product; Dedicated customers can configure retention and obtain exports.
- Evidence: attached audit-log-sample.txt (timestamps and identifiers redacted). We used a deterministic redaction process and included the redaction manifest as a comment at the top of the sample.

Call request: if FinTrust wants to validate the log format and redaction approach, propose a 30-minute technical walk-through next week. Available slots (PST): 2026-08-30 10:00–12:00, 2026-08-31 14:00–16:00.

Attachments: fintrust_control_matrix_filled_template.xlsx, audit-log-sample.txt

Regards,
